title: Topology Recommendation Rules
description: ADR-0104 / GT-430. Declarative rules that map technical signals to recommended topologies. ADVISORY: Core recommends (in Discovery), the tenant confirms (in Design). `progressive` rules pick one base axis topology (highest matching priority; modular-monolith is the safe default); `dimensions` rules each add a composable topology when their signals match.

when.description: Signal conditions. Boolean keys must equal the signal value; `teamCountMin` requires signals.teamCount >= its value. An empty/absent `when` always matches (default rule).
